summary:
Plan of w111 (delivery#r17, r18) written to plan.md.
Delivery is a guarantees capability (decision 0065): no scenarios and nothing runs red; the work is in the skill text alone.
File set: skills/delivering-an-initiative/SKILL.md only. scripts/work, scripts/workqueue.py, scripts/features_report.py and their tests are dropped.
r17: the skill appends ## Retires (exact quoted titles, with file) after work add, then commits the work-item files alone. No --retires CLI option (work-queue is out of scope).
r17: the skill reads the deprecated scenarios' own @r<n> tags from features/, not deprecated --json.
r18: the check runs before the first work add, because work add commits itself; on a miss the skill stops, names the scenarios and drafts nothing.
Tests broken: none. Five open cases are left to name.
